title: Knowledge in the Harness, Reliability in the Weights: Teacher-Free Co-Evolution of an LLM Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.15268v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small open models suit private customer-service deployments but trail frontier models in two ways: they miss what the written policy requires in a given situation, and they act inconsistently on what they know. We study whether such a model can close both gaps from its own deployment logs and their reference outcomes, without a stronger teacher model. Our starting point is a Gemma 4 12B agent that reads its domain policy from on-demand skills rather than from its system prompt. In each round, the deployed system serves a fresh batch of tasks; the base model diagnoses failed conversations and writes rules into the skills, and a rule survives only if it passes code checks, counterexample self-review, a paired retest, and a noise-calibrated validation gate. Reinforcement learning (GRPO) then trains a LoRA adapter on complete multi-turn, tool-using conversations. On the retail and airline domains of $\tau^2$-bench, without training or sele

translated_title: 知识在框架中，可靠性在权重中：无需教师模型的LLM智能体协同进化
translated_abstract: 小型开源模型适合私有客服部署场景，但在两个方面落后于前沿模型：它们无法识别特定情境下书面政策所要求的内容，并且在已知知识上的行为表现不一致。我们研究这样的模型能否仅凭自身的部署日志及其参考结果来弥补这两个差距，而无需更强的教师模型。我们的起点是一个 Gemma 4 12B 智能体，它从按需加载的技能中读取领域政策，而不是从系统提示词中读取。在每一轮中，部署的系统处理一批新任务；基础模型诊断失败的对话并将规则写入技能中，一条规则只有通过代码检查、反例自审、配对复测以及噪声校准的验证门槛后才能保留。随后，强化学习（GRPO）在完整的多轮、使用工具的对话上训练 LoRA 适配器。在 $\tau^2$-bench 的零售和航空领域上，无需训练或人工选择……
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需更强教师模型的自进化框架：小型LLM智能体通过诊断自身部署日志中的失败对话自动编写政策规则并经多重验证筛选入技能库，再用GRPO强化学习在完整多轮工具使用对话上训练LoRA适配器，从而同时弥补政策知识缺失与行为不一致两大缺陷。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a teacher-free co-evolution framework in which a small LLM agent autonomously diagnoses failed conversations from its own deployment logs, writes policy rules into on-demand skills that survive multi-stage validation checks, and then trains a LoRA adapter with GRPO-based RL on complete multi-turn tool-using conversations, closing both the policy-knowledge and behavioral-consistency gaps without a stronger teacher model.
